name: Bílichov (Czechia)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and green, with three red roses arranged in a triangle in the centre of the white stripe.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 April 2008 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
